sourceTitle: The Trail-Hunter: A Tale of the Far West
description: "The Trail-Hunter: A Tale of the Far West" by Gustave Aimard is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The narrative centers around the adventures of frontier hunters in the rugged landscapes of New Mexico and entangles various characters who embody the struggles and conflicts of the region during this era.
